text:
maria: Heads up — eu-west2 GPU pool `g4a-prod` is degrading, seen steady node drain and a rising queue for generation requests over the last 12m. Autoscaler triggered but provisioning lagging. Incidentbot created an alert a few mins ago.

pagerbot: Incident P2 created: infra.gpu.capacity.eu-west2. Current metrics: free_gpus=22%, queued_sessions=130, avg_queue_time=5.2s. Paging on-call.

aj: On it. I'm digging into eviction and scale events. Maria, can you paste recent `kubectl get events` / eviction logs?

maria: Paste of trimmed events:
```
Type    Reason        Age   From                Message
Normal  ScaleUp       10m   cluster-autoscaler  Added 3 nodes to pool/g4a-prod-eu2 (max=120)
Warning Preemption   9m    kubelet             Pod default/worker-xyz evicted due to Preemption
Warning Evicted       8m    kubelet             Pod default/worker-abc evicted: node pressure
```
Looks like preemptions spiked after a maintenance window in that AZ.

sanjay: That matches spots reclaiming. eu-west2 spot churn increased ~3x. Suggest temporarily tilting new traffic to eu-west1 and bringing reserved capacity up in eu-west2 if possible. Tilt helps avoid cold-start churn.

lei: I can flip the routing but want to avoid overloading eu-west1. Recommend 30-50% tilt for new sessions, drain existing sessions. Also propose tweaking incidentbot thresholds: immediate page if sustained free_gpus < 20% for 5m, escalate to P1 if <10% for 10m.

maria: Proposal: route 40% of new sessions to eu-west1, session-drain true, and change incidentbot so P2 fires at <20% for 5m, P1 only if <10% for 10m. That avoids noisy P1s while giving us time to react. Thoughts?

ops-bot: Runbook change request recorded: `runbooks/infra/gpu-capacity -> draft:adjust-eu-west2-tilt-policy` by maria.

aj: I'll apply tilt now. Command: `infractl route-tilt --from eu-west2 --to eu-west1 --percent 40 --session-drain true`

aj: Running command...

aj: Tilt applied. Watching streaming metrics. Autoscaler also starting additional reserved nodes (+6 requested).

sanjay: Seeing queue length drop and preemption rate fall. Eviction events down to single digits. Nice.

maria: Great. I'll prepare a handoff to night oncall in ~25m. @karen you'll be handed this watch — expecting to keep an eye until autoscaler finishes and free_gpus >25% for 15m.

karen: Acknowledged. Can you drop the revert command in thread so I can run it if we need to roll back quickly?

aj: Revert command: `infractl route-tilt --revert --from eu-west2 --to eu-west1` (this reverts the most recent tilt operation).

maria: Follow-ups: create ticket to request longer-term quota bump for eu-west2 spot and evaluate switching critical pools to reserved to reduce preemption risk. I'll open a ticket after handoff.

maria: Current snapshot: free_gpus=24%, queued_sessions=62, avg_queue_time=2.1s. We aim for >25% sustained for 15m before closing active watch.

karen: Will monitor. Will escalate to P1 immediately if free_gpus drops below 15% or queue_time >10s for 10m.

aj: Noted. Leaving metrics dashboards on the oncall screen.

maria: Thanks all — marking incident as "watch" not "resolved". I'll update the runbook with the tilt recipe and incidentbot threshold changes.

karen: Got it. I'll take handoff at T+25.
